Method of Attack: Executing on disk or in memory files
Launching protocols for self-exit or deletion
Attack Vector: Tests if it’s operating in a sandbox environment, executing meaningless tasks if so
If opened by an actual user, it grabs the system’s data and connects to its C2
On macOS devices, uses a multi-step process to maintain persistence, executing as Root, disabling Gatekeeper, and adapting the name “com.%s.appbackgroundservice”

On Windows systems, can create a service and initiate its execution, or create a Windows Terminal profile using “C:\users$env:UserName\AppData\Local\Packages\Microsoft. WindowsTerminal_*\LocalState\settings.json

Can steal information from Chrome and Firefox browsers, including history, cookies, profile files, browser credentials, password encryption keys, and target crypto wallet extensions and exfiltrate files and folders
